_comment: Acknowledged post-freeze changes to frozen files. Each entry: path, old_sha256 (the manifest/log hash), new_sha256 (LF-normalised hash now on disk), reason, date. Empty means no frozen file has been touched.

changes.reason: performance only, decisions identical: packed interned row-id sets in the worker and incremental bitset analysis in analyze() (the G9 live run stalled ~90 min in the quadratic set-based analysis of the civil-war pipeline); never-reused object keys in the worker; see docs/EVAL-14-GUARD-SPEED.md. Results produced before this change stay tied to the old hash.

test_frozen_eval12_hashes_match_doc now also accepts a guard_g9.py hash that differs from the frozen doc only when docs/FROZEN-CHANGELOG.json records exactly that old hash (the one in the frozen doc) and the new on-disk hash; any unrecorded change still fails. Test-only change, no result or run file touched.

security: new preload_heavy() imports the libraries first, then _block_network(), then import train, so the module-level code of an untrusted train.py runs under the network / file / spawn / ctypes block (it ran before the hook existed). _block_network itself unchanged.

security: preload_heavy() (incl. the KNN ctypes warm-up) then _block_network() before import train; same order as run.py. Results unchanged (byte-identical on 6 factorial cases, tests/test_sandbox_hardening.py).

security: child processes run via sandbox/limits.run_limited (Windows Job Object memory + process limits, POSIX rlimits); limit hits reported as status error with a "limit" field; docker command gains --memory/--pids-limit (UNVERIFIED path). No change to results.

security: worker does preload_heavy(); _block_network(); then import train (was import train first); workers run through sandbox/limits.run_limited; limit hits reported as error. Cached values unchanged but the cache key (runner file hash) changes, so old cache entries are not reused.
security: smoke runner does preload_heavy(); _block_network(); then import train; runs through sandbox/limits.run_limited; limit hits reported as error.

security: the guard worker now preloads libraries, then installs sandbox/run._block_network() before exec of the compiled source (it had no sandbox at all), and is launched via sandbox/limits.run_limited. Trace content unchanged. Second change after the 2026-11-02 speed change: old_sha256 is again the hash in the manifest / frozen doc.
